data.name: Admiral Yi: The Imjin War
data.detailed_description:
The Imjin War has begun.

After more than two centuries of peace, Joseon is suddenly invaded by Japan, whose armies have been hardened by a century of civil war. Cities fall one after another, the royal court is thrown into chaos, and the nation stands on the brink of collapse.

Only one man can change the course of history.

Take command as Admiral Yi Sun-sin, lead the Joseon navy, secure cities and naval bases, defeat invading Japanese forces, and fight to save your nation. Follow the events of history—or rewrite them through your own strategy.

Features

■ Become Admiral Yi Sun-sin

Lead one of history's greatest naval commanders and change the fate of Joseon.

■ Real-Time Grand Strategy

Command armies and fleets across the Korean peninsula in a large-scale real-time strategy experience.

■ Large-Scale Naval Warfare

Take direct control of powerful fleets and fight massive naval battles against invading forces.

■ Capture Cities and Secure Supply Lines

Expand your territory, protect vital supply routes, and maintain your military strength.

■ Command Officers

Recruit and utilize officers with unique strengths to develop your own strategy.

■ Rewrite History

Relive the Imjin War or forge an entirely different future through your decisions.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 7 8840U / Intel Core i5-8400 or equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6GB / AMD Radeon RX 580 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended. Performance may vary depending on battle size and unit count.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 7 8840U / AMD Ryzen 7 7700X / Intel Core i7-12700 or better
  • Memory: 24 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 / AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT or better
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Recommended for large-scale battles with thousands of units.
